name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the dumbbell beside one thigh, palm facing inward.
Keep your elbow pinned close to your torso and curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder while keeping your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze your biceps and forearm briefly at the top of the curl.
Lower the dumbbell to your side, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your wrist neutral and avoid turning your palm upward as you lift.
Prevent your torso from swaying or leaning away to create momentum.
